title: pulicaria viscosa
intro: Pulicaria viscosa, commonly known as sticky fleabane, is a perennial herb native to the Mediterranean region. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, including its potential to treat a range of health issues such as fever, cough, and digestive problems, due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Pulicaria viscosa include its anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties, which contribute to its use in treating various conditions. The bioactive constituents of Pulicaria viscosa include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
